validity.researcher_notes: Gillis Access Project is a real, TC Energy-operated greenfield transmission pipeline in Louisiana, confirmed by EIA releases (announced 2023, construction 2024, completed 2024, in-service 2024). Capacity 1500 MMcf/d and length 42 mi match EIA records. StartYear1=2024 aligns with in-service date. Status is operating as of EIA Aug 2026 release (status 'Completed'). Route has null geometry (no digitization yet). Project serves Haynesville Shale production routing to Gulf Coast LNG export facilities.

cross_row_leads.facts: NG3 project by Momentum Midstream also ends at Gillis hub; 275 mi, 1700 MMcf/d, operating status, in-service 2025. Interconnect, not duplicate of P5416.
Gulf Run Pipeline by Energy Transfer also terminates at Gillis area; 135 mi, 1650 MMcf/d, operating, in-service 2022. Separate project, interconnects at Gillis hub.

summary: P5416 Gillis Access Project (TC Energy, LA, 42 mi, 1500 MMcf/d, operating) confirmed real and correctly classified. All specifications verified against EIA Aug 2026 release (high-tier, multi-release consistency); ownership/operation verified. Status stable (operating). Three MISSING_VALUE units (Pressure, Diameter, Operator blank) resolved as UNRESOLVED (Pressure, Diameter) or REFS_ADDED (Operator, 9 HAS_REF units reverified). EIA is only accessible independent source; second sources for all major specs outstanding.
